.. _adding-anthropic-claude-code:

Adding Anthropic and Claude Code to Smarter
===========================================

Goal
----

We will use Claude Code with Smarter to write and test a small Python
function, with every request routed through NAPL's own Smarter platform
instead of going straight to Anthropic.

Along the way you will register Anthropic as an LLM provider (one-time,
administrator task) and connect your own Claude Code installation to it
(every programmer).

Prerequisites
-------------

You are expected to be comfortable with:

- A command line (PowerShell, bash, or zsh) and environment variables.
- Reading and writing YAML.
- Python and ``pytest``, and Node.js/npm (Claude Code is installed with npm).
- REST concepts: base URLs, API keys, HTTP status codes.

Setup
-----

Have the following ready before you begin.

**Administrator, one time only (Part 1)**

- Smarter v0.16.0 or later, running, with an administrator account.
- The Smarter CLI, installed and logged in. See the
  `Smarter CLI <https://docs.smarter.sh/smarter-framework/smarter-cli.html>`__
  documentation.
- An Anthropic API key from `console.anthropic.com <https://console.anthropic.com/>`__.
- Shell access to the Smarter deployment, to edit ``.env`` and run management
  commands.

**Every programmer (Part 2)**

- Your existing Smarter login.
- Node.js 18 or later.
- An empty project folder with Python and ``pytest`` available.

.. danger::

   Never commit API keys, Anthropic or Smarter, to version control.

Concept Overview
----------------

Four names are easy to mix up, so fix them first:

- **Claude** is the family of models (for example Sonnet and Opus).
- **Anthropic** is the *provider* that hosts those models behind an API.
- **Claude Code** is a coding agent that runs in your terminal. It is a
  *client* of the Anthropic API, not a model, so there is nothing called
  "Claude Code" to register. What you register is the provider and its model.
- **Smarter** sits in the middle and governs access.

Smarter manages every resource the same way: you write a YAML file called a
Smarter API Manifest (SAM) and apply it with the CLI, much like Kubernetes.
A manifest has four parts: ``apiVersion`` (always ``smarter.sh/v1``),
``kind``, ``metadata`` (name, description, version) and ``spec``.

Two resource kinds matter here:

**Provider**
   Registers an LLM backend and one of its models. On apply, Smarter calls
   the provider's API to verify that the model is reachable.

**Proxy**
   Gives passthrough access to the provider's API. Callers use the
   provider's own SDK or tool unchanged, but point it at a Smarter URL and
   authenticate with a *Smarter* API key. Smarter adds the real Anthropic key
   (stored as a Secret), forwards the request, and records token usage. The
   Anthropic key never reaches developers' machines and can be rotated in one
   place.

.. code-block:: text

   Claude Code ──Smarter API key──▶ Smarter Proxy ──Anthropic key──▶ Anthropic API

Step-by-Step
------------

Part 1: Register Anthropic (administrator)
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

**Step 1. Add the Anthropic key to Smarter.**
Add this line to the ``.env`` file at the root of the Smarter deployment,
then restart so it is loaded:

.. code-block:: bash

   SMARTER_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
   make restart

**Step 2. Generate a template manifest.**

.. code-block:: bash

   smarter manifest provider

This prints a valid example. Compare your own file against it if validation
fails later.

**Step 3. Write the Provider manifest.** Save as ``anthropic-sonnet.yaml``:

.. code-block:: yaml

   apiVersion: smarter.sh/v1
   kind: Provider
   metadata:
     name: anthropic-sonnet
     description: Anthropic Claude Sonnet, for NAPL custom programming
     version: 1.0.0
   spec:
     provider:
       name: anthropic
       model: claude-sonnet-4-6

.. note::

   Model identifiers are case-sensitive and must match Anthropic's published
   names exactly. Check
   `Anthropic's model list <https://docs.anthropic.com/>`__ for current names.
   To offer more than one model, write one manifest per model.

**Step 4. Apply it and confirm it is active.**

.. code-block:: bash

   smarter apply -f anthropic-sonnet.yaml
   smarter describe provider anthropic-sonnet

Verification is asynchronous. If the ``status`` block shows ``pending``,
wait 30 seconds and run ``describe`` again.

**Step 5. Confirm the Anthropic Proxy exists.**

.. code-block:: bash

   smarter get proxies

Smarter ships a built-in ``anthropic`` Proxy that allows only inference
paths (``v1/messages``, ``v1/messages/count_tokens`` and ``v1/models``). If it
is not listed, for example because you added the key after first deployment,
run these on the Smarter deployment, then list the proxies again:

.. code-block:: bash

   python manage.py initialize_providers
   python manage.py add_builtin_proxies

Part 2: Connect Claude Code (every programmer)
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

**Step 6. Create a Smarter API key.**
In the Smarter web console, open **API Keys** and create a key for yourself.
Copy it immediately. This is the only key you will ever give Claude Code.

**Step 7. Install Claude Code.**

.. code-block:: bash

   npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code
   claude --version

**Step 8. Point Claude Code at Smarter.** Claude Code reads its endpoint and
credentials from environment variables. Use the Proxy URL, which stops at
the proxy name, *without* ``/v1``, because the client adds that itself.

.. code-block:: bash

   # macOS / Linux
   export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="https://<your-smarter-host>/api/v1/proxy/anthropic"
   export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="<your Smarter API key>"
   export ANTHROPIC_MODEL="claude-sonnet-4-6"

.. code-block:: powershell

   # Windows PowerShell
   $env:ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL = "https://<your-smarter-host>/api/v1/proxy/anthropic"
   $env:ANTHROPIC_API_KEY  = "<your Smarter API key>"
   $env:ANTHROPIC_MODEL    = "claude-sonnet-4-6"

Use the same model name you registered in Step 3. To make these permanent,
add them to your shell profile.

**Step 9. Start Claude Code.**

.. code-block:: bash

   mkdir leap-year-demo && cd leap-year-demo
   claude

If Claude Code asks whether to use the custom API key, approve it.

Proof of Concept
----------------

At the Claude Code prompt, enter:

.. code-block:: text

   Create leap_year.py with a function is_leap_year(year), and
   test_leap_year.py with pytest tests covering 1900, 2000, 2024 and 2023.
   Then run the tests.

Approve the file writes when prompted. You should see Claude Code create both
files and run ``pytest``, ending with output similar to:

.. code-block:: text

   ======================== 4 passed in 0.02s ========================

That result proves the whole chain works: Claude Code reached Claude through
your Smarter Proxy using only your Smarter key. As a second check, the
administrator's ``smarter describe provider anthropic-sonnet`` output should
include:

.. code-block:: yaml

   status:
     verified: true
     active: true

Troubleshooting
---------------

**401 Unauthorized.**
   The Smarter API key is missing, mistyped, or revoked. Check that
   ``ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`` is set *in the shell where you started* ``claude``,
   and that it holds the Smarter key, not an Anthropic ``sk-ant-`` key.

**404 ``proxy_not_found``.**
   The URL is wrong. It must end in ``/api/v1/proxy/anthropic``. Do not add
   ``/v1`` or ``/v1/messages``.

**403 ``path_not_allowed``.**
   The request used a path the Proxy does not permit. The built-in Anthropic
   Proxy allows only ``v1/messages``, ``v1/messages/count_tokens`` and
   ``v1/models``. Ask your administrator before widening ``allowedPaths``.

**402 ``budget_exceeded``.**
   A Smarter budget has locked further charges for you, your team, or the
   Proxy. Contact your administrator.

**503 ``proxy_misconfigured``.**
   The Proxy has no usable Anthropic key. The administrator should confirm
   ``SMARTER_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`` in ``.env``, restart Smarter, and rerun the
   two ``manage.py`` commands from Step 5.

**Provider status stays ``pending`` or shows "verification failed".**
   Wait 30 seconds first. If it persists, the Anthropic key is invalid or
   revoked: create a new one, update ``.env``, and restart.

**Apply error: "Model not found".**
   The ``model`` value does not match Anthropic's identifier. Identifiers are
   case-sensitive.

**Manifest validation errors.**
   Almost always YAML indentation. Compare your file with the output of
   ``smarter manifest provider``.

.. seealso::

   - `Smarter Provider <https://docs.smarter.sh/smarter-resources/smarter-provider.html>`__
   - `Smarter Proxy <https://docs.smarter.sh/smarter-resources/smarter-proxy.html>`__
   - `Smarter API Manifests <https://docs.smarter.sh/smarter-resources/provider/manifest.html>`__
